title: API conventions
description: Northstar internal APIs use short-lived bearer tokens issued by the identity service.

title: Customer feedback workflow
description: Record customer feedback in the Feedback Board with a short summary, source channel, and affected product area.

title: Data handling principles
description: Northstar classifies information as Public, Internal, or Restricted.

title: Expense reimbursement
description: Submit expense claims in Finance Portal within 30 calendar days of the purchase.

title: Your first week
description: During your first week, start by activating your company account, setting up multi-factor authentication, and reading the onboarding checklist.

title: Laptop setup
description: IT Support provides an enrolled laptop with disk encryption and endpoint protection enabled.

title: Learning and development
description: The fictional Northstar learning allowance is 600 euros per employee per calendar year.

title: Meeting room handbook
description: Reserve a meeting room by adding its resource calendar to the event invitation.

title: Account recovery
description: To reset your account password, use the identity portal self-service reset flow and verify with your registered second factor.

title: Northstar product overview
description: Northstar is a fictional workspace for small teams managing customer projects.

title: Production release checklist
description: A production release requires a reviewed pull request, passing automated tests, a successful staging smoke test, and a documented rollback plan.

title: Writing release notes
description: Write release notes for customers using plain language.

title: Remote work guide
description: Remote team members should be reachable during core collaboration hours from 10:00 to 15:00 UTC, excluding their scheduled break.

title: Rollback runbook
description: Start a rollback if a new release produces a sustained error rate above 2 percent for five minutes or breaks the checkout smoke test.

title: Secrets and API keys
description: Store service secrets in the approved secret manager and inject them as environment variables at runtime.

title: Report a security incident
description: To report a security incident, open an urgent Security Desk ticket and notify the security on-call through the internal incident channel.

title: Staging access
description: To request access to the staging environment, open an Access Desk ticket and choose the Staging role.

title: Customer support priorities
description: P1 means a customer cannot use a core workflow and no workaround exists.

title: Time off and leave
description: Request annual leave in People Portal at least ten working days before the proposed start date.

title: VPN troubleshooting
description: If the VPN will not connect, first check your internet connection, restart the VPN client, and verify that your device clock is correct.
